entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane of the Worldwake flavor text, a wild world whose terrain shifts and which is called a brutal taskmaster.

entities.name: Emeria
entities.description: A divine being in whose name an archon raises his sword until she is freed.

entities.name: Cosi
entities.description: A volcano-associated being whose followers include the Ravager creature.

entities.name: The Roil
entities.description: Zendikar's destructive upheaval, which Ilori says reveals the world's secrets.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Ancient beings whose relics are said to have left Zendikar forever enraged.

entities.name: Malakir
entities.description: A place with great families, nulls and jungle gates that adventurers are driven toward.

entities.name: Goma Fada caravan
entities.description: A nomadic caravan whose mages harness both life and death.

entities.name: Joraga
entities.description: A tribe of elves on Zendikar, home to the hunter Saidah.

entities.name: Mul Daya
entities.description: The Mul Daya elves, who reject their Tajuru kin as arrogant tree-binders.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: Elves who devised ways to let the forest defend itself.

entities.name: Bruse Tarl
entities.description: A Goma Fada nomad who speaks of hurdas as guards and of moving as the earth does.

entities.name: Amadi
entities.description: A Halimar griffin-master training a fledgling griffin.

entities.name: Saidah
entities.description: A Joraga hunter who speaks of the world's looted life force and her battle cry.

entities.name: Anitan
entities.description: An Ondu cleric who senses misfortune on the wind.

entities.name: Ilori
entities.description: A merfolk falconer who speaks of the Roil.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who comments on memory and on nature's wrath against magic users on Zendikar.

entities.name: Isanke
entities.description: A Halimar seastalker.

entities.name: Maizah Shere
entities.description: A Tazeem lullmage.

entities.name: Alubri
entities.description: A Guul Draz gatekeeper.

entities.name: Chadir the Navigator
entities.description: A guide who warns about jagwasp swarms.

entities.name: Zahr Gada
entities.description: A Halimar expedition leader who tests recruits' breath-holding.

entities.name: Nundari
entities.description: A Sea Gate militia captain.

entities.name: Zakken
entities.description: An Enclave cleric who says Cosi has many followers.

entities.name: Screed
entities.description: A voice of the Mul Daya quoted on the Roil and on the Novablast Wurm.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker on Zendikar who holds a treasure map and likes the place for its extra mana.

entities.name: Anowon, the Ruin Sage
entities.description: A vampire scholar who says many died searching for a map and warns that relics may watch back.

entities.name: Sachir
entities.description: A member of the Akoum Expeditionary House.

entities.name: Gotzen
entities.description: A Bulwark explorer.

entities.name: Noyan Dar
entities.description: A Tazeem lullmage who says the Lodestone Golem warps the Aether.

entities.name: Javad Nasrin
entities.description: An Ondu relic hunter.

entities.name: Gribble
entities.description: A goblin who rode down a mountainside and became the legendary Skrill Tamer.

entities.name: Grotag
entities.description: A goblin tribe whose members cheered Gribble.

entities.name: Remhas
entities.description: A mage who regretted using his most powerful spell.

entities.name: Berko
entities.description: A person on a bridge that snapped over a swamp.

entities.name: Kazuul
entities.description: A tyrant whose mines a speaker once toiled in.

events.summary: Gribble rides a bucking creature down the mountainside while his Grotag brethren cheer, and the legend of the Skrill Tamer is born.
events.quote: legend of the Skrill Tamer was born

events.summary: A bridge snaps beneath Berko, who is sure the swamp is laughing at him.
events.quote: As the bridge snapped, Berko was sure he heard the swamp laughing at him.

events.summary: Remhas casts his most powerful spell and regrets it in his last seconds.
events.quote: In his last seconds, Remhas regretted using his most powerful spell.

relations.note: Described as a Goma Fada nomad.
Anowon scorns Chandra as an arrogant child holding the map.
The Mul Daya elves reject their Tajuru kin.
relations.quote: The Mul Daya elves reject their Tajuru kin
